name: roadrunner-build-rrhd-map
description: Build, convert, and import RoadRunner HD Maps (.rrhd) in MATLAB. Author lanes, lane boundaries, markings, junctions, signs, barriers, and speed limits with roadrunnerHDMap; convert Lanelet2 (.osm, Autoware) maps to RRHD; resolve RoadRunner road asset paths for markings, crosswalks, signs, signals, and barriers; and import or build .rrhd or OpenDRIVE (.xodr) files into a RoadRunner scene. Use when creating road networks for driving simulation, converting Lanelet2 or other HD map sources to RRHD, looking up road asset paths, or loading and verifying a map in RoadRunner or RoadRunner Scene Builder. Not for building scenes from recorded sensor data, running simulations, or recreating OpenSCENARIO (.xosc) scenarios.
